payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design a playful, toy-like interface with soft 3D, chunky elements, bubbly aesthetic, rounded edges (16-24px), thick borders (3-4px), double shadows (inner + outer), pastel colors, smooth animations. Perfect for children's apps and creative tools.
payload.best_for: Educational apps, children's apps, SaaS platforms, creative tools, fun-focused, onboarding, casual games
payload.css_technical_keywords: border-radius: 16-24px, border: 3-4px solid, box-shadow: inset -2px -2px 8px, 4px 4px 8px, background: pastel-gradient, animation: soft bounce (cubic-bezier 0.34, 1.56)
payload.do_not_use_for: Formal corporate, professional services, data-critical, serious/medical, legal apps, finance
payload.effects_and_animation: Inner+outer shadows (subtle, no hard lines), soft press (200ms ease-out), fluffy elements, smooth transitions
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Border-radius 16-24px, ☐ Thick borders 3-4px, ☐ Double shadows (inner+outer), ☐ Pastel colors used, ☐ Soft bounce animations, ☐ Playful interactions
payload.keywords: Soft 3D, chunky, playful, toy-like, bubbly, thick borders (3-4px), double shadows, rounded (16-24px)
payload.primary_colors: Pastel: Soft Peach #FDBCB4, Baby Blue #ADD8E6, Mint #98FF98, Lilac #E6E6FA, light BG
payload.secondary_colors: Soft gradients (pastel-to-pastel), light/dark variations (20-30%), gradient subtle
